_source: Synthetic hard case: the top screw-puzzle mechanic with a new garden theme.
name: Bolt Garden: Screw Puzzle
subtitle: Unscrew pins, solve wood nuts
description:
Welcome to Bolt Garden, the most relaxing screw puzzle game! Unscrew the bolts in the right order to free the wooden plates and clear the board. Hundreds of levels of satisfying screw jam fun with a beautiful garden theme.

- Easy to play, hard to master
- Use boosters when you get stuck
- Collect coins and unlock new garden themes
- Play offline anytime

Train your brain and relax with Bolt Garden!
